docs.summary: Provides an interface for optional logging and performance tracking of the Recast build process. This class does not provide logging or timer functionality on its own. Both must be provided by a concrete implementation by overriding the protected member functions. Also, this class does not provide an interface for extracting log messages. (Only adding them.) So concrete implementations must provide one. If no logging or timers are required, just pass an instance of this class through the Recast build process. @ingroup recast
Where Warn and Log go when a host sets one. Static because a build owns a context per thread, so there is no single instance to configure; unset, messages go to the console.
